description: This file declares functions and constants related to NTLM authentication protocol, including hash generation, response creation, proof input, and channel binding hash calculations, used in NTLMv1 and NTLMv2 implementations.

methods.name: Create3DesKeysFromNtlmHash
methods.description: Maps NTLM hash bits into three DES keys with proper parity.

methods.name: GenerateNtlmHashV1
methods.description: Generates NTLMv1 hash from a password.

methods.name: GenerateResponseDesl
methods.description: Creates NTLMv1 response field using DES.

methods.name: GenerateNtlmResponseV1
methods.description: Generates NTLMv1 response for a given password and server challenge.

methods.name: GenerateResponsesV1
methods.description: Generates both LM and NTLM responses for NTLMv1.

methods.name: GenerateLMResponseV1WithSessionSecurity
methods.description: Creates LM response with extended session security.

methods.name: GenerateSessionHashV1WithSessionSecurity
methods.description: Creates session hash for NTLMv1 with extended security.

methods.name: GenerateNtlmResponseV1WithSessionSecurity
methods.description: Generates NTLMv1 response with session security.

methods.name: GenerateResponsesV1WithSessionSecurity
methods.description: Generates responses for NTLMv1 with extended session security.

methods.name: GenerateNtlmHashV2
methods.description: Generates NTLMv2 hash from domain, username, and password.

methods.name: GenerateProofInputV2
methods.description: Creates proof input vector for NTLMv2.

methods.name: GenerateSessionBaseKeyV2
methods.description: Generates session base key for NTLMv2.

methods.name: GenerateMicV2
methods.description: Calculates Message Integrity Check for NTLMv2.

methods.name: GenerateUpdatedTargetInfo
methods.description: Updates and generates target info for NTLM authentication.
